metaDescription: Shopify checkout showing as unavailable? Learn how to check payment settings, fix gateway errors, and update domain and SSL to get orders flowing again.
intro: A "Checkout Unavailable" message on Shopify usually means something in your payment setup, checkout configuration, or theme is preventing customers from completing an order. This guide covers the main causes and how to work through them so your store can process orders again.

steps.heading: Check your payment provider settings
steps.body: Review your active payment provider in Shopify Admin to confirm it's properly connected and not showing any setup errors.

steps.heading: Look for checkout configuration issues
steps.body: Go through your checkout settings to spot any misconfigurations that could be blocking the checkout process entirely.

steps.heading: Rule out theme or app conflicts
steps.body: Temporarily disable recently added apps or check for theme customizations that might be interfering with checkout.

steps.heading: Confirm your domain and SSL status
steps.body: Verify your domain is properly connected and that SSL is active, since checkout can become unavailable if the store isn't securely reachable.

steps.heading: Test the full checkout flow
steps.body: Once changes are made, walk through a full test order to confirm customers can now reach and complete checkout without issues.

faq.question: What usually causes "Checkout Unavailable" on Shopify?
faq.answer: It's commonly tied to a payment provider that isn't set up correctly, misconfigured checkout settings, or a conflict from a theme or app.

faq.question: Can an app cause checkout to break?
faq.answer: Yes, certain apps can interfere with checkout, so temporarily disabling recently installed ones is a useful troubleshooting step.

faq.question: Does SSL status affect checkout availability?
faq.answer: Yes, an SSL or domain connection problem can prevent checkout from loading properly for customers.

faq.question: How do I confirm the issue is fixed?
faq.answer: Running a complete test order through checkout is the most reliable way to confirm the problem is resolved.
